entity.name: Media, politics and economy in modern Southeast Asia

facts.value: This module serves to connect different thematic strands of the Master's programme. The discipline-specific approaches of linguistics and cultural studies to questions of social, political and economic change in Southeast Asia will be exemplarily conveyed and theoretically considered through the analysis of linguistic expressions and discourses. The thematically and linguistic-regionally defined core themes of the course of study will be particularly important as common elements in this module.
